# Captured key-list unregister operation

JavaScript excerpts and whole parents test a bounded operation: guard two captured
values, delete concatenated captured keys through a local alias, and call two
independently guarded unregister members. External getter behavior, call success
and native network purpose remain unproved.

[The integration target](../../naming_operation_captured_key_list_unregister.rs)
reads the excerpt list from [provenance.json](provenance.json), which records
fixture names, original spans and capture navigation. Representative forms are
[stateful-parent-expanded.js](stateful-parent-expanded.js) and
[work-batch-parent-compact.js](work-batch-parent-compact.js); branched, forwarding,
numeric and checkbox-parent variants retain independent layout controls.

[stateful-whole-parent.js](stateful-whole-parent.js) establishes the operation in
its full context. [canonical-whole-parent.js](canonical-whole-parent.js) verifies
that the stronger teardown_xhr_instrumentation evaluator keeps precedence.
[Operation unit tests](../../../src/naming/operations/captured_key_list_unregister_tests.rs)
also use the expanded stateful excerpt.

Tests permute distinct capture ports and reject broken alias links, guards,
member receivers, callback pairs and effects. Preserve source bytes, original
spans, member names and manifest relationships; never execute these captures.
Read next: [single-callback removal](../network-captured-key-removal/README.md)
and [the fixture collection](../).
